Reward weights and what the terms mean

Each 2 s step, built like the training reward. Area: new area covered. OPTV: how much the boundary of the uncovered area shrank (borders along the no-fly zone do not count). Both are scaled so a fresh straight step is worth 1: flying into open area adds boundary (−1), flying next to covered ground adds none, closing a gap removes some. At the goal the remaining boundary is released at once. Turning and time cost per step. A step inside the hot zone earns only the hot penalty. Weights start at the training code's defaults.

About: a research demo of an AI pilot for radiation-mapping flights. The scenarios are simulated releases, not real or predicted events. No cookies, no tracking. The map and the 3D view stream Google photorealistic 3D tiles (through Cesium ion), drawn with three.js and 3d-tiles-renderer, with terrain heights from Mapzen terrain tiles on AWS Open Data. The flat-map option shows Esri World Imagery (Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics) instead. Place search: Photon by komoot, © OpenStreetMap contributors. Code, model and data are not licensed for reuse.
